evaluation: Render actual production faces and measure fixed component F1 at both tiers. Require paired reference/input/font/alignment identity. Report failures and the union of alignment warnings; verify every pixel outside the stats region is unchanged. MIR/TMP/M21 regression cohorts must remain byte-identical. No per-card scan transform.
